Drop writes no text of a hidden element or a template

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"hidden_content\":\"Drop\"}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>visible</p><div role=\"tabpanel\" hidden>tab two body</div><template><p>row template</p></template>", options)
    println(result.content)
}
```
